I've answered Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That number comes from her own messages in #north-team, a channel she's in. On Aug 20, 2025 she posted 180 seats (amendment signed Aug 19), then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. I couldn't open the amendment itself, so I suggested she check the signed copy before the deck goes out.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it didn't need approval. I didn't use any information she couldn't see herself.
